breakdown.description: Engineering stress is defined with the original area A_0, not the final area A_f.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly follows the incorrect definition from the incomplete prompt, using the final (deformed) area A_f = 115 mm^2 instead of the original area A_0 = 130 mm^2. The agent even acknowledges the error in a note but still proceeds with the wrong formula and wrong area value, producing 365.22 MPa instead of the correct result of 323.08 MPa (42,000 N / 130 mm^2). The inconsistency was not resolved.
